stageSize.$description: Height of the area that holds the check, rings, stamp or sparkles.

checkPopScale.$description: Check: how far the check overshoots as it springs in.

ringScale.$description: Rings: how large each ring grows before it fades.

stampFrom.$description: Stamp: starting size before it slams down.

stampAngle.$description: Stamp: the angle it lands at.

sparkleDistance.$description: Sparkles: how far from the check the sparkles appear.

confettiLight.$description: Confetti pieces for a light amount.

confettiNormal.$description: Confetti pieces for a normal amount.

gravity.$description: Confetti gravity, in pixels per second squared.

sparkLife.$description: Fireworks: seconds before a spark fades away.

sendDelay.$description: How long the simulated submission takes.

characterHeight.$description: Fenex: height of the character animation.

characterSettle.$description: Fenex in a celebration: how long he plays before settling into his still pose (moving content must stop or be pausable within 5 seconds).
